title: Langur spa day

scenes.headline: Grooming follows rank
scenes.body: Dominant langurs groom each other — and get groomed — more often than lower-ranked ones.

scenes.label: of their time is spent on the ground

scenes.headline: Troops of 2 to 100+
scenes.body: Langurs are highly social; group size varies hugely.

caption:
Ten minutes of grooming is ten minutes of politics.

Langurs are mainly leaf-eaters: leaves make up about half to three-fifths of their diet.

Source: Animal Diversity Web, Semnopithecus entellus. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Single wild Indian CC clip, slowed to a calm 'cute' loop with social-behaviour facts. HIGH-RISK format: cute-animal clips are only OK with our own footage; this is a template for that.
